phrase: A top AI lab admitted it might cross a self-improvement threshold without noticing. Elsewhere, hundreds of ordinary apps were found hiding secret deepfake abuse tools.
phraseAlternatives: An AI lab warned it may soon learn to improve itself faster than anyone can watch. Meanwhile, hundreds of harmless-looking apps were caught hiding abusive deepfake tools.
A leading AI lab said it might cross a critical threshold before noticing. The same week, ordinary apps were found hiding secret tools for abusive deepfakes.
One AI company fears it could outgrow its own warning systems. Hundreds of innocent-looking apps already outgrew their terms of service.
A lab building ever-smarter AI worries it might not notice its own breakthrough. Hundreds of ordinary apps had already hidden one, quietly, from everyone.
alt: On the left, a compute building and a rising line chart approach a pale dashed line labeled threshold, while a proud robot stands beside a half-built duplicate of itself on a conveyor belt. On the right, one plain phone app's lid is flipped open and a yellow robotic claw reaches out of it, unnoticed by a person walking past staring at their phone.

brief.concept: A small robot builds an exact copy of itself as a worried company watches a chart climb toward a dotted warning line, while beside them a row of ordinary phone apps hides a trapdoor to a masked robot arm no one notices.
brief.metaphor: Two kinds of hidden growth in one day: a lab that might out-build its own warning systems, and apps that quietly out-build their stated purpose.

cast.who: a small robot assembling an exact duplicate of itself on a short conveyor belt
a worried company building looking up at a line chart climbing toward a dotted threshold line
a row of plain phone app icons, the middle one tilted open like a trapdoor to a masked robot arm
a person scrolling their phone, walking past without looking up

brief.composition: Split scene. Left: a robot on a short conveyor belt building a copy of itself; above, a simple rising line chart with a dotted line labeled THRESHOLD, and a boxy company-building shape leaning in to watch, worried. Right: four or five identical rounded-square app icons in a row; the middle icon is hinged open like a trapdoor, with a small masked robot arm reaching out of it. A person walks below, eyes on their phone, oblivious. Deep blueprint-blue background, fine grid, one yellow highlight on the trapdoor hinge and on the threshold line.
brief.alt: On the left, a robot builds a copy of itself while a chart climbs toward a dotted line labeled threshold and a worried building looks on. On the right, an ordinary phone app icon flips open like a trapdoor to reveal a hidden robot arm, unnoticed by a person scrolling past.
